infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GuideAI uses the camera to describe your surroundings and to read sign language. Video is processed on this device and never stored.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: GuideAI listens so another person's speech can be captioned and translated into sign language.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GuideAI uses your location and heading to guide you along pavements, crossings and traffic.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: GuideAI uses motion sensors to know which way you are facing while navigating.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: GuideAI transcribes speech so it can be shown as captions and signed back to you.
